title: International Aviation Composites receives U.K. CAA Part-145 approval
summary: This expands the company's ability to support helicopter operators and maintenance providers serving the U.K. market.
body_markdown:
IAC Ltd. (International Aviation Composites) has received U.K. Part-[145](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/rotor+x/145) Maintenance Organisation Approval from the United Kingdom Civil Aviation Authority (CAA), expanding its ability to support helicopter operators and maintenance providers serving the U.K. market.


The approval complements IAC’s existing Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) approvals for helicopter rotor blade maintenance and repair.


Issued Oct. 30, 2026, under approval reference UK.[145](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/rotor+x/145) .50982, the approval authorizes IAC to perform maintenance and issue associated release-to-service documentation in accordance with U.K. CAA requirements, within the scope of its existing FAA Part[145](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/rotor+x/145) Repair Station approval.


“Receiving U.K. CAA approval is an important milestone for IAC and strengthens our ability to serve customers across international markets,” said Randy Stevens, IAC president. “Together with our FAA and EASA approvals, this authorization enables us to support the rotor blade maintenance needs of U.K. operators and maintenance providers while maintaining our focus on quality, responsive service and efficient turnaround times.”


Founded in 1992 and based in Fort Worth, Texas, IAC specializes in inspecting, maintaining, and repairing helicopter main and tail rotor blades. Its capabilities include composite and metal skin repairs, leading-edge abrasion strip replacement, structural repairs, and blade balancing.


The U.K. CAA approval is valid through Oct. 29, 2028, subject to continued regulatory compliance.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by IAC Ltd.*
